title: subagent-summary-v1
description: Role-switch summary emitted by every Nyxowl subagent.

status.description: One of done, blocked, or handoff.

role.description: Agent id that produced the summary.

slice.description: Slice identifier or short slice name.

receipts.description: Receipt id/status pairs backing the summary.

contractsPublished.description: Blackboard contracts published by the role.

openIssues.description: Unresolved issues for the next role.

nextAction.description: The next action or role transition.
